question:
Which of the following terms will come in place of question mark (?) in the given series?

SDR, XHU, CLX, ?, MTD, RXG
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

Logic : (5), (4) and (3) is added to the first, second and third letter position value according to the English alphabetic series respectively. 

​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff313554dfaa194983e145795693a391a0db95b21c1151e4cf4a8201c159798c.png] ​

Hence, "**HPA**" is the correct answer.
